scope: Source-level explanation of the previously recorded 64 KiB worker-clone reproduction. No new engine build or runtime pass is claimed.
finding: The worker-message serializer retains shared memory backing without its address type. The deserializer explicitly recreates it with Wasm::AddressType::I32. This explains why a module requiring i64 memory rejects the cloned memory while a fresh i64 memory works in the same worker.
classification: Confirmed engine implementation gap for the tested experimental Memory64/pthreads path. It is not an inherent Lean or WebAssembly restriction, and it does not affect the passing Wasm32 application finalizer checks.
nextStep: The native Memory64 path requires an engine change or another backend. Continue unchanged-suite coverage with the recorded lowered-memory64 configuration, retaining its 4 GiB capacity limitation.
